create_dataset_subclass: create a subclass of Dataset that implements _load_data to yield items from a data source
implement_load_data: implement the abstract _load_data method in a Dataset subclass to return an iterator over data
iterate_dataset: iterate over a Dataset subclass instance using a for loop to process each data item
use_next_on_dataset: call next on a Dataset instance to retrieve the next item from the underlying data iterator
review_dataset_abc: review the Dataset abstract base class and its iterator protocol implementation for correctness
